projects.title: Fetal Distress Risk Stratification from Cardiotocography
projects.headline: Cardiotocography Fetal Risk Classification & SHAP Explanations
projects.summary: Developed an explainable machine learning model to classify fetal health into Normal, Suspect, or Pathological states using 21 cardiotocography features. Applied class-weighted LightGBM with 5-fold cross-validation and TreeSHAP to make model decisions transparent and clinically interpretable for doctors.
projects.challenge: The clinical dataset had severe class imbalance, with only 8.3% pathological cases. Standard classifiers favored the majority class, so I used class weighting and probability threshold tuning to minimize dangerous false negatives without hurting overall specificity.

projects.title: AutoVisCheck: Intelligent EDA & Audit Platform
projects.headline: Interactive Exploratory Data Analysis & Chart Validation Tool
projects.metricHighlight: 4-Stage Guided Workflow · 5 Smart Imputation Modes · Replayable Operation Log
projects.summary: Built an interactive Streamlit app that walks users through data cleaning, smart exploratory data analysis, and chart sanity-checking. It automatically detects column data types, suggests appropriate statistical summaries, and flags common visualization flaws like truncated axes before generating exportable reports.
projects.challenge: Many exploratory tools either make destructive modifications to raw datasets or generate misleading visualizations. I designed a non-destructive pipeline with a replayable operation history so users can review, audit, or revert every data transformation step.

projects.title: Explainable ML for Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)
projects.headline: Predicting Ciprofloxacin Resistance in E. coli
projects.summary: Built a machine learning pipeline to predict ciprofloxacin resistance in E. coli from mass-spectrometry clinical records spanning 2015 to 2018. Used XGBoost and TreeSHAP to identify which laboratory features most strongly signal drug resistance, providing interpretable insights for antibiotic stewardship.
projects.challenge: Clinical hospital records often contain co-tested antibiotic results that leak the target label into the feature space. I designed a strict data sanitization step that stripped out target-correlated testing artifacts before training to ensure the model learned genuine biological markers.

projects.title: Sepsis Survival XAI: Calibrated Mortality Benchmark
projects.headline: Well-Calibrated Sepsis Mortality Risk Prediction
projects.metricHighlight: 110,204 Patient Records · Brier Score Reduced from 0.223 to 0.066
projects.summary: Created a calibrated risk prediction model to estimate in-hospital sepsis mortality from routine clinical variables. Combined gradient boosting with Platt scaling to deliver reliable risk probabilities rather than raw uncalibrated scores, paired with individual patient SHAP waterfall charts.
projects.challenge: Raw boosting models often output extreme, poorly calibrated probability estimates when trained on low-prevalence outcomes (under 8% mortality). I used Platt scaling on a held-out split to align predicted risks with actual observed hospital mortality rates.

projects.title: Pediatric Immunization Surveillance & Dropout BI
projects.headline: Global WHO/UNICEF Childhood Vaccination Tracking
projects.metricHighlight: 195 Countries · 16 Vaccines · 20+ Years of WHO/UNICEF Data
projects.summary: Designed an end-to-end analytics platform tracking pediatric vaccination coverage across 195 countries from 2000 to 2023. Built a Python ETL pipeline to clean and reshape multi-sheet WHO/UNICEF spreadsheets into a structured SQLite database, connected to an interactive Power BI dashboard tracking completion dropouts.
projects.challenge: The official global registries were spread across inconsistent, wide-format Excel files with missing regional records. I wrote automated Python scripts to clean and unpivot the data, then authored DAX measures to isolate regional coverage drops during the COVID-19 pandemic.

projects.title: SARS-CoV-2 Genomic Variant Clustering via k-mers
projects.headline: Alignment-Free Sequence Clustering for Viral Genomes
projects.metricHighlight: ~30,000 Complete Viral Genomes · 341 k-mer Features Analyzed
projects.summary: Developed an alignment-free genomic analysis pipeline to cluster roughly 30,000 SARS-CoV-2 sequences. By extracting oligonucleotide k-mer frequency profiles and combining PCA with MiniBatchKMeans, the system identifies distinct viral clades quickly without requiring slow multiple sequence alignments.
projects.challenge: Aligning tens of thousands of full-length viral genomes using traditional tools requires prohibitive compute time and memory. Using k-mer frequency spectra allowed rapid, scalable clustering of massive genomic sequences on standard hardware.

projects.title: Real-Time CNN Face Recognition Pipeline
projects.headline: Live Video Face Detection & Identity Classification
projects.metricHighlight: Custom Labeled Dataset · OpenCV Pipeline · TensorFlow CNN
projects.summary: Built an end-to-end computer vision system for real-time face detection and recognition from live webcam feeds. Collected and preprocessed a custom facial dataset with OpenCV, then trained a compact convolutional neural network optimized for fast inference on modest hardware.
projects.challenge: Live video feeds suffer from fluctuating room lighting, motion blur, and slight face angles. I added data augmentation during training (random brightness, rotation, and zooming) and frame-averaging during inference to keep predictions steady.

projects.title: Haunted Theme Park: Interactive 2D OpenGL Simulation
projects.headline: Animated Day-Night Cycle & Interactive Carnival Simulation in C++
projects.metricHighlight: C++ & OpenGL/GLUT · Real-Time Day-Night Transition · Procedural Animations
projects.summary: Built an interactive 2D animated theme park simulation in C++ using OpenGL and the GLUT graphics library. The simulation features synchronized day-and-night cycles, procedural ride animations (Ferris wheel, carousel, and drop tower), a flowing river with boat traffic, and dynamic behavioral transitions between daytime park-goers and nighttime ghostly transformations.
projects.challenge: Coordinating multiple simultaneous rendering loops—such as independent rotational speeds for rides, water ripple physics, and seamless palette shifts between daytime and haunted night scenes—required efficient state management within GLUT's idle and timer callbacks without dropping frame rates.

projects.title: Cart Crush: Retail & Financial Inventory ERP
projects.headline: Retail Management, Inventory Tracking & Invoicing System
projects.metricHighlight: C# .NET · SQL Server · Automated Invoicing & Auditing
projects.summary: Developed a desktop management application in C# .NET and SQL Server for retail stores. Features include multi-user role management, inventory tracking with reorder alerts, transaction processing, receipt generation, and sales auditing reports.
projects.challenge: Multiple simultaneous sales transactions could cause race conditions in stock counts. Implemented database transactions with ACID-compliant locking in SQL Server and structured form validation to keep stock levels and billing strictly in sync.
